notes.title: Play our demo on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Attention, pinball enthusiasts! We're really excited to release a demo of Car Mechanic Flipper to you today as part of Steam Next Fest 2023. Get ready to dive into the exciting world of automotive repair and pinball action like never before.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592878/a6769e39c4168786682649bd63de6bad079366cc.png[/img]

To celebrate the release of our demo, we cordially invite you to join us at the upcoming Steam Game Festival. Discover Car Mechanic Flipper firsthand and be among the first to experience the excitement. Engage with our passionate development team, provide valuable feedback, and get a taste of what's to come in the full version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592878/ed906b28dd5e1ee41150fe618a3347fe7fcf5d49.png[/img]

See you at the Steam Game Festival, and let's rev up the excitement together!

Sincerely,
The Car Mechanic Flipper Team
